faq.q: What can I use coins for?
faq.a: Coins unlock Fast Pass episodes and chapters before they become free. Unlocked episodes stay in your library.
No. Purchased coins never expire. Bonus coins from events may have an end date, shown when you get them.
KHQR works with any Bakong-member bank app. You can also pay with ABA Pay or a credit or debit card.

faq.q: I paid but didn’t get coins
faq.a: Most payments confirm in seconds. If it takes longer than 10 minutes, contact Help with your order number.
